message.riseofempires.granary_outside_cl: The Granary Seal must stand inside your camp's claim to name a store. It is placed, but it counts nothing yet.
message.riseofempires.granary_sealed: %1$s now keeps its store in the chests within %2$s blocks of this seal.
message.riseofempires.granary_unsealed: The Granary Seal is gone. %1$s no longer counts those chests as its store. The items remain in the chests.
